Summer's saying goodbye and Azucar's throwing it a Blackout Party it'll never forget. 🖤⚡ DJ Gioboomin takes the decks for a night of pure Electronic | House energy — bass that rattles your ribs, lights slicing through the dark, a crowd moving like one body. This is the last hurrah before fall creeps in, so you go all out or you don't go at all. Green jacket, black shades, and a set built to send summer off right — Gioboomin's not here to ease you in, he's here to turn it up. Grab pre-sale before the door price hits, because this floor fills fast once word gets out. 🔥🕶️

📅 Friday, September 18 — Doors 9PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Pre-sale $13 / At the door $16
🔞 Ages 16-20
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #BlackoutParty #EndOfSummer #DJGioboomin #HouseMusic #ElectronicNight #PascoNightlife

DJ Rafael's closing out summer the only way he knows how — loud, relentless, and full send. 🎧🖤 Azucar's Main Floor turns into a blackout haven for one night, Electronic and House sounds stacking up until the whole room's moving together. Rafael's known for keeping the energy locked in from the first drop to the last, and this End of Summer send-off is exactly the stage for it. Cap pulled low, jersey on, ready to work the crowd all night. This is the kind of Friday you plan around — pre-sale tickets go for less, doors open at 9, and once that bass hits you'll wish summer never ended. 🌙🔊

📅 Friday, September 18 — Doors 9PM
